title: knx-interop client result document
description: The last line of stdout of `run client <op>` (docs/CONTAINER_CONTRACT.md): one document per operation. The exit status follows status: 0 pass, 1 fail, 3 unsupported. Members the contract does not name are allowed.

op.description: The operation, as given on the command line.

durationMs.description: Measured; 0 when the adapter answers at once.

data.description: What the operation reports (the contract's table of operations); empty when there is nothing.

error.description: Why the operation failed or is unsupported.
